questions.question: Fourteen persons can do a work in 18 days. After 5 days of work, 6 workers left the work, and joined back on the last day of the work. In how many days the work got completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

14 persons can do a work in 18 days

After 5 days 6 workers left.

These 5 workers joined on the last day of work.

**Concept used:**

If each person can do 1unit of work per day then n persons can do 1 × n unit work per day.

**Calculation:**

Let each person can do 1 unit of work per day

So,

⇒ 14 persons can do = 1 × 14 = 14 units/day

⇒ In 18 days, 14 persons can do = 18 × 14 = 252 units (Total work to be done)

Now,

In first 5 days, 14 persons completed

⇒ 14 × 1 × 5 = 70 units

In last day, 14 persons competed

⇒ 14 × 1 = 14 units

Then,

the total work completed in 6 days = 84 units

Now,

Work left =168 units

And persons left = 14 - 6 = 8 persons

So,

Time taken by 8 persons to complete to leftover work

⇒ 168/(8 × 1) = 21 days

So,

time taken to complete the whole work = 5 + 21 + 1 = 27 days

**∴ The work got completed in 27 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e630b14d2ee5628012926bab01c7d3942a022fe09561b571af5a0b41d387d3fa.png] 

So, total days = 27

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers A and B is 5 : 8. If 5 is added to each of A and B, then the ratio becomes 2 : 3. The difference in A and B is:

**∴ The difference in A and B is 15**

questions.question: A sold an article to B at a profit of 25%. B sold it to C at a profit of 15%. The profit made by B is Rs. 40 less than the profit made by A. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article for A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sold an article to B at a profit of 25%.

B sold it to C at a profit of 15%.

The profit made by B is Rs. 40 less than the profit made by A.

**Concept used:**

Profit = S.P. – C.P. (S.P. = Selling price, C.P.= Cost price)

S.P. = C.P. + (C.P. × profit%)

**Calculation:**

Let A bought the article for Rs.100x 

A sold it to B at [100x + (100x × 25%)] = Rs.125x

Profit earned by A = (125x – 100x) = Rs. 25x

So,

B bought the article for Rs. 125x 

B sold it to C at [125x + (125x × 15%)] = 143.75x

Profit earned by B = (143.75x – 125x) = Rs. 18.75x

According to the question,

25x – 18.75x = 40

⇒ 6.25x = 40

⇒ x = 6.4

So,

A bought the article for (100 × 6.4) = 640 Rs.

**∴**** The cost price (in Rs.) of the article for A is 640.**

questions.question: Weight of A is 20% more than weight of B, whose weight is 30% more than weight of C. By how much percent weight of A is more than weight of C?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Weight of A is 20% more than weight of B

weight of B is 30% more than weight of C.

**Concept used:**

Final Value = Actual Value + (Actual value × %age increase)

**Calculation:**

Let value of C be 100x

Value of B = 100x + [(100x × 30)/100] = 130x

Value of A = 130x + [(130x × 20)/100] = 156x

So,

The weight of A is (156x – 100x) = 56x more than C.

The weight of A is (56x × 100)/100 = 56% more than C

**∴**** The weight of A is 56% more than C**

questions.question: The average of squares of five consecutive odd natural numbers is 233. What is the average of the largest number and the smallest number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of squares of five consecutive odd natural numbers is 233.

**Concept:**

(A + B)² = A² + 2AB + B²

(A – B)² = A² - 2AB + B²

**Calculation:**

Let the consecutive odd numbers be (a - 4), (a - 2), a, (a + 2), (a + 4)

Now, according to the question

⇒ [(a - 4)² + (a - 2)² + a² + (a + 2)² + (a + 4)² ]/5 = 233

⇒ (a² – 8a + 16 + a² – 4a + 4 + a² + a² + 4a + 4 + a² + 8a + 16)/5 = 233

⇒ (5a² + 40)/5 = 233

⇒ a² + 8 = 233

⇒ a² = 225

⇒ a = 15

So,

The largest number = 15 + 4 = 19

The lowest number = 15 – 4 = 11

So,

The average of these two numbers = (19 + 11)/2 = 30/2 = 15

 **∴The**** average of the largest number and the smallest number is 15**

questions.question: If sin(20 + x)° = cos 60°, 0 ≤ (20 + x) ≤ 90, then find the value of 2sin²(3x + 15)° - cosec²(2x + 10)°.

⇒ sin(20 + x)° = sin30°

⇒ x° = 30 - 20 = 10°

**∴ Required answer is - 3**

questions.question: In a circle with center O and radius 13 cm, a chord AB is drawn. Tangents at A and B intersects at P such that ∠APB = 60°. If the distance of AB from the center O is 5 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of AP?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius = 13 cm

∠APB = 60°

The distance of AB from the center O is 5 cm

**Concept used:**

If from one external point, two tangents are drawn to a circle then they have equal tangent segments.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4182ac20cbc3482fd4f34bd99e4c49f678b2e9cf66481d65077335c571af8bc.png] 

Since OM = 5(given)

OA = 13 (given)

Using Pythagoras theorem

AM = 12

As AB = 2 AM(Perpendicular from the center bisect the chord in equal part)

AB = 2 × 12 = 24.

In ΔPAB,

∠APB = 60° (given)

As PA = PB (as two tangents are equal from the same point)

So ΔPAB will be an equilateral triangle.

So, AP = 24 cm

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] __Confusion Points__**There is a mistake in the question in this official paper because we get different answers by taking ΔAPM and ΔAPO.

We know that the radius from the center of the circle to the point of tangency is perpendicular to the tangent. Hence ΔAPO is also a right-angled triangle. So in ΔAPO,

tan 30° = OA/AP

⇒ 1/√3 = 13/PA 

⇒ AP = 13√3 which is not given in the options.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Conditions for similarity of triangles:

**Angle-Angle-Angle:** If in two triangles, corresponding angles are equal, then their corresponding sides are in the same ratio (or proportion), and hence both triangles are similar.

**SSS (Side-Side-Side): **If in two triangles, the sides of one triangle are equal to are proportional to the sides, then their corresponding angles are equal, and hence both triangles are similar.

**SAS (Side-Angle-Side):** If the angles of a triangle are equal and the sides including these angles are proportional, then both triangles are identical.

questions.question: If sec(5α - 15°) = cosec(15° - 2α), then the value of cosα + sin2α + tan(1.5α) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sec(5α - 15°) = cosec(15° - 2α)

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13e15d912a95c91c83020164df4dce95fbb15d21ba7e6918817ece86f526ce31.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9993c810b089d3856c4ad7c7d2bcbfbf2a0d703c9a206c75cf98977204a6e4b4.png] 

**Calculation:**

sec(5α - 15°) = cosec(15° - 2α)

⇒ sec(5α - 15°) = cosec(90 - 15° + 2α)

⇒ sec(5α - 15°) = sec (75° + 2α)

⇒ 5α - 15° = 75° + 2α

⇒ 3α = 75° + 15°

⇒ α = 30°

cosα + sin2α + tan(1.5α)

⇒ cos30° + sin60° + tan45°

⇒ √3/2 + √3/2 + 1

⇒ (√3 + √3 + 2)/2

⇒ (2√3 + 2)/2

⇒ 2(√3 + 1)/2

⇒ (√3 + 1)

**∴ Required answer is (√3 + 1)**
